summary: Backend-only regression + NEW version-restore feature validation. Created /app/backend/tests/test_version_restore.py (16 tests, all PASSED in 2.45s). Verified: (1) admin login with admin@hikayati.dz returns a valid JWT and wrong password yields 401; (2) all admin regression endpoints (GET /api/admin/stats, /orders, /coupons, /tickets, /settings) return 200 with the token; (3) partial-regen endpoints POST /admin/orders/{id}/regenerate-text and /regenerate-page/{n} return {ok:true} on a real order and 404 on a fake order; (4) NEW POST /admin/orders/{id}/restore-version/{v} — 401 without token, 404 for missing order, 404 for non-existent version_num on a real order, and {ok:true} 200 for a real order after triggering a snapshot via regenerate-text (version snapshot was observed via GET /admin/orders/{id} within a few hundred ms — versions[] populated); (5) backend startup smoke via GET /api/config = 200 proves pdf_service.py RTL changes did not break imports/startup. Did NOT wait for fal.ai background jobs to complete, as instructed.

minor.issue: Endpoint returns 401 when no Authorization header is sent (FastAPI HTTPBearer default), which matches the review requirement. Consider also documenting that restore is fire-and-forget (background asyncio task) — response {ok:true} does not confirm the actual rebuild finished. Non-blocking.

action_items: NONE — all 16 targeted assertions pass. New feature (version restore) meets contract.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_restore_version guards order existence AND version existence BEFORE spawning the background task — good defense-in-depth, matches the review's 404 requirements.
restore_version_task() correctly snapshots the CURRENT state first via snapshot_version(order) so a restore is itself reversible — good design.

regenerate_single_page() now writes to versioned paths page_{n}_{tag}.png / coloring_{n}_{tag}.png so previous images survive rollback — matches the review-notes intent and is required for restore_version_task._rebuild_pdfs to find historical images from prior snapshots. LGTM.
pdf_service.draw_text_block wraps logical text then reshapes per line (RTL fix) — no import/startup regression detected (/api/config 200).
server.py is now ~871 lines — still recommend splitting admin routes into a sub-router (unchanged from iteration 3/4).
seed_data_creation: None — reused an existing 'review' order with pages=5 already in the DB; triggered regenerate-text on it to create a version snapshot for the restore test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_version_restore.py picks the first 'review' order with non-empty pages from GET /admin/orders and reuses it for regenerate/restore checks. If that ordering ever changes or the DB has no 'review' orders with pages, the version-restore snapshot test will pytest.skip rather than fail. Fal.ai background work is intentionally NOT awaited. RTL PDF fix and version-restore feature are both contract-verified.
rca of the issue: No issues — feature works as spec'd.
